top_signals.title: Imperial Brands to axe 2,500 jobs as tobacco firm hunts savings
top_signals.summary: Imperial Brands expects to slash up to 2,500 jobs in the coming years as the tobacco giant hunts for £320m in savings. The FTSE 100 firm revealed on Tuesday it will cut between 2,100 and 2,500 further jobs across its international operations before 2030.
